title: Topic 12: Places in Town & Directions - Reading
description: Two short texts with three questions each.
canDoStatement: Identify places in town, ask for and follow simple directions

readingBlock.readingText:
TEXT A - Handwritten directions format
HOW TO GO TO MY HOUSE - for Rita
From the station:
1. Go straight on Park Street.
2. Turn right at the supermarket.
3. My street is next to the school.
My house is number fifteen. It is small and very nice.
There is a big tree next to the door!
- Nara

TEXT B - Chat messages format
Kito: Is there a supermarket near your new apartment,
      Faye?
Faye: Yes! It is next to the station. And there is a
      big park on my street!
Kito: Nice! And a hospital?
Faye: There is one, but it is not near.
Kito: And your bank?
Faye: Very near - turn left at my door, and it is there!
